1 Purpose and conformance target
This speciﬁcation tells a reviewer how to decide whether one exact candidate conforms to SCI-MAP v0.2. It does
not select a candidate, inspect an implementation, execute validation, or assert a result. Before work begins, the
reviewer freezes:
• repository and immutable candidate identity;
• build proﬁle, compiler/runtime identities, conﬁguration, and enabled parallel modes;
• exact input ﬁxtures and independent expected-value generators;
• numerical comparison policy and simultaneous statistical error policy;
• required product list, representation paths, log policy, and completion criteria; and
• the shared-authority digest, contract version, this document revision, owner-decision ledger revision, exact byte-
identical PTC-to-MAP boundary digest, exact original-footprint-coordinate boundary, source-bound MAP pro-
ﬁle versions, six product-role identities, coadd Registry record, owner r0.2 directive identity/digest, and the
exact candidate paired SCI-VAL_PROFILE_REGISTRY v0.1/r0.3-map-v0.2-r0.2-candidate-2026-09-07 and SCI-VAL_SOURCE_
BINDING_REGISTER v0.1/r0.3-map-v0.2-r0.2-candidate-2026-09-07 records. Candidate records are not treated as owner-
accepted, canonically activated, or frozen merely because their bytes and hashes are complete.
Evidence from a diﬀerent candidate, conﬁguration, or science-authority digest is not silently pooled. Each rerun
keeps its own identity and reason. Historical operational acceptance does not substitute for conformance evidence.
The exact MAP lifecycle is requested, effective, observation_resolved, applied, realized, in that
order. requested is immutable accepted intent. effective is its supported executable interpretation.
observation_resolved means every observation-speciﬁc parent, coeﬃcient, proﬁle, geometry, mapping, pa-
rameter, support rule, output role, and persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. applied binds
the exact resolved operation and parameter state to the invocation or commitment of one execution attempt.
realized binds the immutable resulting accumulators, products, statuses, failures, and provenance that were
actually produced. A stop before application has neither an applied nor a realized record. An applied attempt that
terminates before output realization retains its applied-attempt identity and exact terminal failure but creates no
realized product.
MAP stage Exact meaning Record rule
requested Immutable accepted intent. Exists only for an accepted request; it is
never reconstructed from a later stage.
effective Supported executable interpretation of that
request.
Binds supported/disabled/unavailable

proﬁle, geometry, mapping, parameter, support
rule, output role, and persistence decision is
concrete or typed unavailable.

when output realization fails.

statuses, failures, and provenance were actually
produced.
Created only for actual realization; it
never authorizes its own earlier
application.

application but before output realization.
The former has neither applied nor
realized record; the latter has an
applied-attempt record and terminal
failure but no fabricated realized
product.
The MAP plan, coeﬃcient selection/application, projection, support policy, output/coadd plan, response/covariance request,
product role, and coverage_cut use this same ordering. Each parameter stage binds its exact value and provenance; a
completed realization contains all ﬁve stages, while an earlier stop contains only stages actually reached.
The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested,
applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown, eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and
realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or
evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter’s resolved or applied value may be checked
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 2

before application or bound after application; its realized value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application check.
2 Evidence record
Each requirement record contains at least:
Field Required content
Requirement Stable SCI-MAP-REQ-NNN and shared-authority digest.
Candidate Exact source/build identity and environment proﬁle.
Observable Public product, typed state, API boundary, metadata, diagnostic, or failure
transition under test.
Fixture Immutable input identity and independent expected-value calculation.
Comparison Exact predicate or preregistered numerical/statistical bound.
Result Exactly one of pass, fail, blocked, not_applicable, or not_assessed.
Skipped required evidence is not_assessed, never a pass.
Artifact realization Exactly one of complete, incomplete, failed, or not_produced; this
records the evidence artifact and never substitutes for the requirement
result.
Artifacts Machine-readable outputs, logs, traces, plots/tables where needed, and
digest-addressed provenance.
Reviewer Independent reviewer identity, date, and deviation disposition.
Every ECS requirement result is exactly one of pass, fail, blocked, not_applicable, or not_assessed. pass
means complete positive evidence establishes the requirement for the exact candidate. fail means evaluated evi-
dence contradicts it. blocked means evaluation cannot proceed because one exact named authority, dependency,
proﬁle, source binding, or prerequisite is unavailable. not_applicable means the requirement is outside the exact
candidate’s declared role under an owner-approved rationale. not_assessed means applicable evidence has not
yet been executed or reviewed. Evidence-artifact realization is a diﬀerent axis with values complete, incomplete,
failed, and not_produced.
Failures are retained as evidence. A tolerance, ﬁxture, expected result, or applicability decision is not changed after
viewing a failure without opening a new preregistered record.

All nine stable MAP scope decisions are decided for this candidate. A claim may still be blocked by an unapproved
source binding, an unavailable producer, or missing conformance evidence; record that state without weakening the
requirement or substituting a fallback.
4 Execution order and atomicity protocol
Run evidence in the following order so later evidence cannot mask an earlier contract failure:
1. Stage A—structural. Parse and freeze exact identity and parent, generation, source/proﬁle binding, producer
availability, and required decision realization for frozen PTC r0.5, the exact PTC-to-MAP boundary, and the
AST same- n signal coordinate, all boundaries/proﬁles, units, lifecycle, WCS, MAP policy, and required-product
plan. When the uniform route is selected, require the exact uniform Registry, family, and handoﬀ identities
declared in the shared authority; selection alone supplies no coeﬃcient and creates no default. Reject direct CAL,
PTC-disabled, missing-product, inferred no-op, and cross-generation routes before payload retrieval.
2. Stage B—safe numerical classiﬁcation. Retrieve only structurally admitted transformed-signal and coeﬃ-
cient payloads. Classify zi as ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, or unrepresentable and γi as ﬁnite strictly positive, exact zero,
negative ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, or unrepresentable. Verify coeﬃcient availability itself imposed no ﬁniteness require-
ment. Separately validate the exact observation-resolved coverage cut before application: zero, ordinary (0, 1],
above one admitted only by an independently authorized same-value/scope coverage_cut_above_one_override_
requested fact, or invalid when missing, non-ﬁnite, negative, or unrepresentable. The number above one never
authorizes itself. Invalid input fails before support construction, application, or mutation; no realized cut value
is a pre-application prerequisite.
3. Stage C—coordinate and product. Evaluate exact AST coordinate validity, one-hot placement/boundary,
and only the companions required by the exact selected observation/coadd product role. For every V AL-evaluated
gate retain request, applicability, eligibility, and realization axes, source binding, immutable reason, cause, and
failure scope. Only requested/applicable/eligible/realized passes. Verify separately that the PTC coeﬃcient/QC
pass uses its exact PTC-owned proﬁle and neither replaces nor rescues SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2.
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 4

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.2
4. Stages D and E—membership then accumulation. Construct membership only after Stages A–C and
perform no payload arithmetic until all required gates pass. Verify no numeric-zero mask, late masking, or ag-
gregate sanitization substitutes for admission. Then compare exact scientiﬁc output-row identity and cardinality,
plus one-pixel, one-hot half-open-boundary, prohibited-fractional, covariance, ﬁxed-state response, full-procedure
comparison-space typing, and distinct-fact observation outputs, to independent expected values; retained storage
rows do not count as scientiﬁc output rows.
5. Exercise original-footprint exposure ﬁxtures: one original inﬂuencing several descendants at diﬀerent pixels; orig-
inal and descendants in diﬀerent pixels; missing original coordinate; boundary loss; multiple maps sharing one
original; distinct observations with numerically identical original coordinates; and donor/synthesized descendants.
Verify exact observation/UID/native/stable-ALIGN-slot/generation keys, layered AST ALIGN-grid parent in the
target WCS, one own-coordinate placement, separate inﬂuence edges, and no precision or temporal-support pro-
motion.
6. Verify complete immutable observation-bundle construction as a logical artifact. Independently request all three
observation roles and record each reached requested, eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized plan
stage; a completed realization has all ﬁve, a pre-application stop has no applied/realized records, and an applied
terminal failure has no realized product. Exercise required publication for persisted routes plus explicitly selected
in-memory and coadd-only routes. In-memory retention is not a waived product.
7. Snapshot coadd-owned state; test every compatibility failure under each selected role; require atomic nonmutation.
Conﬁrm that base-permitted unavailable or basis-incompatible response and incomplete covariance preserve the
base signal membership and publish exact status/cause.
8. Evaluate all four axes of the registered observation-coadd admission aggregate proﬁle separately from the MAP
lifecycle; then independently request all three coadd roles and exercise admitted centered-integer coaddition, exact
coadd output-row identity, and companion placement. If a canonical target grid was requested before observation-
map construction, verify that every constructed map honors it. Otherwise verify that already existing compatible
bundles, including persisted coadd-only inputs, may select a common coadd target and use exact centered-integer
embedding without modifying or relabeling their scientiﬁc samples. An explicit crop creates a new row-selected
product with its own identity and provenance.
9. Round-trip all required representations and reconstruct each row-selected operator from provenance. Evalu-
ate the physical FITS and typed WCS on every preregistered scientiﬁcally addressable pixel center and every
outer-footprint cell vertex, including all corners, with the exact index mapping, common WCS generation/frame,
binary64 great-circle metric, and fail-on-invalid rule. Infer no continuum maximum from that ﬁnite population.
10. Exercise ﬁxed-state, PTC full-procedure, and PTC+MAP re-resolved response families. For every numerical ∆ z or
∆ m, require the complete baseline/perturbed identities, quantity/unit, rows, frames/WCS, reference/gauge/null
state, supports, coeﬃcient/response bases, exact common domain and both maps, unmatched-row treatment,
perturbation parameters, ﬁnite-diﬀerence convention, state transition, availability, and cause. Reject implicit
ﬁll, intersection, coordinate/shape/position association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment; a state
delta alone never authorizes subtraction. Reconstruct and disclose the complete MAP-local operator AMAP,Π ,
the immutable realized plan Π , and row selector Jout with its exact output-row domain for every valid prod-
uct, while marking the whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP role unavailable unless a separate approved
authority establishes it; exercise an already realized PTC-grid companion applied exactly once; and honest re-
sponse/covariance disclosure. For a response-bearing role, require only every exact response object named by
that role; absence of a diﬀerent unselected response family does not block it. For coadd covariance, require every
block named by the selected covariance-qualiﬁed role before accepting the complete numerical propagation and
otherwise require partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable state on the base role. Verify
no stronger role subsets an existing base parent and verify versioned binding for later derivative products.
11. Exercise consumer claim boundaries and immutable base/unﬁltered MAP parentage without assuming a closed-
world registry of all future scientiﬁc uses. Verify that Pointing and OOF receive only permission to reuse the exact
ordinary MAP gridding operator when their inputs conform. Their WCS/frame, model/ﬁtting, interpretation,
outputs, defaults, proﬁles, and qualiﬁcation remain mode-owned, and no unsupplied mode proﬁle is activated.
12. Repeat supported execution modes under the preregistered ﬂoating-point policy, while requiring exact discrete
facts.
13. Only after deterministic gates pass, execute representation, external, observational, and operational evidence
appropriate to the requested claim.
For every failure-injection test, capture pre-state, attempted input, emitted diagnostic, post-state, publica-
tion/cardinality state, and completion state. No partial-state comparison may omit a coadd companion merely
because its payload was not the injected failure target.

4.1 Scope-discrimination cases
The following cases make the targeted r0.2 amendments discriminating. Each case records every reached requested,
eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state and asserts role-qualiﬁed atomic nonmutation on rejection.
The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered
MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not
rewrite that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance.

SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization meth-
ods and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-
rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains
unavailable by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional co-
variance, the NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized
signal, and any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims.

5 Canonical requirement conformance clauses
The following clauses are generated from the shared authority. The ﬁrst paragraph is the canonical science require-
ment; the second is its minimum conformance route. Every one of the 52 result ﬁelds is initialized to the exact value
not_assessed; this says applicable evidence has not yet been executed or reviewed and does not describe artifact
realization.
SCI-MAP-REQ-001 – V ersioned authority
Canonical clause: The scientiﬁc contract version shall be v0.2. The rendered document revision shall be recorded separately
as r0.2; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented as a new scientiﬁc contract version.
Minimum conformance evidence: Inspect both artifacts and their machine-readable provenance for distinct contract-
version and document-revision ﬁelds.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-002 – Capability and realized PTC input
Canonical clause: The ordinary input shall be the realized SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed calibrated- x product zi = Z PTC
i ,
a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent detector-time quantity in the inherited top-of-atmosphere, point-source-equivalent
mJy/beam convention with its exact originating ﬁxed-nominal-beam identity. Neither that unit nor a STOKES token establishes
Stokes I. MAP has no CAL-to-MAP fallback, no inferred no-op PTC product, and no product when the required positive-rank
PTC product is absent or PTC is disabled.
Minimum conformance evidence: Exercise exact realized PTC input, attempted CAL input, PTC-disabled and no-product
routes, incompatible PTC generation, missing nominal-beam identity, and attempted Stokes-I promotion.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-003 – Exact occurrence identity
Canonical clause: Every candidate occurrence i shall bind observation, detector occurrence and UID, stable RTC output
sample n, exact PTC product/application generation, segment, and array/network/group as applicable. Sample time is an
associated attribute. Input-column, row, and container positions are locators only and shall not establish identity or equality.
Minimum conformance evidence: Permute times, containers, rows, and columns while preserving or breaking the exact
parent chain; products shall follow exact occurrence identity and reject inferred joins.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-004 – Producer facts and MAP admission
Canonical clause: SCI-MAP shall consume PTC-owned transformed-signal availability, output-retention disposition, co-
eﬃcient family/value/typed availability, and coeﬃcient/QC proposition without reinterpretation. The PTC coeﬃcient/QC
proposition passes only when the coeﬃcient is requested, applicable, eligible, and realized under the exact PTC-owned coeﬃ-
cient/QC proﬁle for the declared MAP-facing family. It does not grant MAP use. SCI-MAP shall separately apply the source-
bound occurrence proﬁle SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2; the manifest-bound SCI-V AL Registry revision binds and V AL
Core evaluates that MAP-authored policy but does not author it. The immutable r0.5 proﬁle SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@1
is historical, is not a compatibility alias, and shall not replace SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Every fact, decision, cause,
scope, and immutable reason remains separately typed.
Minimum conformance evidence: Toggle each producer fact and each of the four named ﬁelds independently; verify exact
PTC coeﬃcient/QC projection, separate MAP admission, preserved causes, source/proﬁle-version rejection, and no rescue or
universal producer-ﬂag action.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-005 – Coordinate and projection authority
Canonical clause: MAP shall consume SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1 for the same stable RTC sample n and
complete parent chain as zi; it shall never join by time, row, cardinality, or coordinate equality. MAP owns Gpi through
SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1: the unique ﬁnite in-grid pixel whose cell contains the coordinate under half-open bounds
contributes Gpi = 1, every other pixel has Gpi = 0, and an outer-upper-boundary or out-of-grid coordinate contributes nowhere.
Fractional projection is deferred. AST may materialize the relation only when the artifact binds the AST parent and exact
MAP plan.
Minimum conformance evidence: Test exact-parent joins, centers, lower and upper cell boundaries, outer extent, invalid
coordinates, sum-over-pixel normalization on its in-grid domain, and prohibited wrap/clamp/fractional placement.
Result: not_assessed
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 9

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.2
SCI-MAP-REQ-006 – Ordinary coeﬃcient status
Canonical clause: The ordinary route requires one explicitly selected PTC-owned MAP-facing analysis/gridding coeﬃ-
cient family satisfying SCI-PTC-REQ-052–055 and SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY v0.2-draft.1/r0.4 . The admitted Registry

SCI-MAP-REQ-009 – Immutable plan and lifecycle
Canonical clause: The exact MAP lifecycle is requested, effective, observation_resolved, applied, realized, in that
order. requested is immutable accepted intent. effective is its supported executable interpretation. observation_resolved
means every observation-speciﬁc parent, coeﬃcient, proﬁle, geometry, mapping, parameter, support rule, output role, and
persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. applied binds the exact resolved operation and parameter state to
the invocation or commitment of one execution attempt. realized binds the immutable resulting accumulators, prod-
ucts, statuses, failures, and provenance that were actually produced. A stop before application has neither an applied
nor a realized record. An applied attempt that terminates before output realization retains its applied-attempt iden-
tity and exact terminal failure but creates no realized product. The same ordered lifecycle shall bind the MAP plan,
coeﬃcient selection and application, projection, support policy, output plan, coadd plan, response and covariance re-
quests, every independently requested product role, and coverage_cut. The MAP lifecycle does not replace the inde-
pendently named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested, applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown,
eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does not replace
the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter’s resolved or
applied value may be checked before application or bound after application; its realized value is never a prerequisite for a
pre-application check. Disabled expert values remain inactive; one observation’s resolved state shall not leak into another.
Minimum conformance evidence: Compare serialized states across two deliberately diﬀerent observations; stop one before
application and one after a terminal applied failure; verify ordered one-way provenance, absence of fabricated applied/realized
products, exact applied-attempt failure, axis separation, and complete replacement.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-010 – F actored contribution predicate
Canonical clause: For each pixel, membership in Cp shall be the conjunction of ten exact Boolean pass predicates derived
from separately retained typed records: transformed-signal availability; PTC output retention; coeﬃcient availability; PTC
coeﬃcient/QC proposition passγ, QC; MAP upstream admission; AST coordinate validity; ﬁnite zi; ﬁnite strictly positive γi; ad-
mitted projection/boundary relation; and MAP-local contribution plus required-companion predicates. Every V AL-evaluated
gate retains named request, applicability, eligibility, and realization ﬁelds; only request= requested, applicability=applicable,
eligibility=eligible, and realization= realized passes. Every other ﬁeld combination is nonpassing with its exact cause, fail-
ure scope, and immutable reason retained. A structural source- or proﬁle-binding failure is recorded only when that structural
condition actually occurs; an ordinary nonpassing ﬁeld value is not thereby a structural failure. Evaluation follows the ordered
DAG: A structural identity/parent, generation, source/proﬁle, producer availability, and decision-realization checks; B retrieval
only of structurally admitted payloads and MAP classiﬁcation of zi and γi; C AST validity, one-hot boundary/placement,
and MAP-local required companions; D membership construction; E accumulation. All gates pass before payload arithmetic.
Reading an authorized payload to classify it is not arithmetic, and excluded non-ﬁnite values never contaminate accumulation.
T/F/U/C or four-ﬁeld records shall never be conjoined directly; no numeric-zero mask represents exclusion.
Minimum conformance evidence: Vary one gate, each of the four named ﬁelds, source-binding failure, and knowledge
state at a time; compare the typed record, Boolean projection, exact DAG stage, membership, cause/scope, and immutable
reason; place NaN/Inf behind structurally excluded and admitted cases to distinguish safe classiﬁcation from arithmetic
contamination.
Result: not_assessed

SCI-MAP-REQ-031 – Adopted threshold selector
Canonical clause: For each declared support-policy population, sort its ﬁnite strictly positive normalization coeﬃcients
Qp; for count N > 0, select zero-based k = ⌊(⌊0. 75N ⌋ + N )/ 2⌋ and Q⋆ = Q(k); for empty input set Q⋆ = 0 . The exact
population and policy identities and each reached requested, eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state/value
of dimensionless c = coverage_cut shall be retained; a completed realization contains all ﬁve. Pre-application admission
shall check the exact observation-resolved value. Application shall bind that value to one support-policy attempt; realization
shall later bind only what was produced. The exact Boolean plan fact coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested shall
bind request identity, authorized owner or proﬁle, scope, each reached lifecycle stage, exact value, cause, and provenance. It
has no applied/realized record before application and no realized record after an applied terminal failure. The scalar shall
be ﬁnite and nonnegative. Exact zero requests no relative cut while ﬁnite strictly-positive Qp remains mandatory. Values
0 < c ≤ 1 are the ordinary recommended range. A value c > 1 is admissible only when that independently authorized fact
is true for the same resolved value and scope; the number cannot authorize itself and may honestly produce empty science
support. Negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable values shall fail before support-row construction, application, or
required-product mutation. No universal numerical default is established.
Minimum conformance evidence: Check N = 0 and small N values around every integer-index transition against the exact

SCI-MAP-REQ-032 – Separate support predicates
Canonical clause: Only after the eﬀective plan and exact observation-resolved cut pass REQ-031 shall application bind
capplied = cobservation_resolved for one support-policy attempt. Numerical normalization support shall then require ﬁnite positive

are inclusive and use the exact declared population and inherited order statistic. At c = 0 , no relative threshold excludes a
row, but no zero, negative, non-ﬁnite, or absent Qp is restored. An authorized expert c > 1 may leave the science-support set
empty. These thresholds are an operational relative-support policy and imply no exposure, precision, signiﬁcance, response,
completeness, or physical optimality. Neither support state establishes ﬁnal validity or precision; no realized value is required
to authorize this pre-application check.

Canonical clause: The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_
bearing_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, SCI-MAP:response_
bearing_coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, or-
dered MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not rewrite
that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance. A SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1
shall exist as one immutable ordered logical bundle before coaddition. It contains signal, numerator, normalization identity,
complete MAP-local realized operator identity, honest upstream-response and uncertainty/covariance identity and status,
the distinct facts in REQ-025, exposure lineage/accounting identity, unit and exact nominal-beam parent, complete AST
frame/WCS, shape/indexing, estimator/projection/proﬁle identities, PTC removed-component/additive-reference/null-space
state, every actually reached stage of the ﬁve-stage MAP lifecycle, exact PTC/AST parentage, and product identity. It may
remain valid when a stronger numerical upstream response or complete covariance is unavailable. Independently requested
SCI-MAP:response_bearing_observation_map@1 and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1 products shall each parent
the exact base observation, bind their own ﬁve-stage lifecycle, and require respectively every named numerical response object
or every named within-observation covariance block. Physical persistence is separately controlled by the eﬀective output plan.
Minimum conformance evidence: Request each observation role independently; remove or alter each required iden-
tity/companion; distinguish absent declarations from honest unavailable states; verify role-speciﬁc failure without base-parent
mutation; and verify identical scientiﬁc content and identity for in-memory and faithfully persisted forms.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-037 – Role-qualiﬁed atomic coadd admission
Canonical clause: A complete observation bundle shall pass every compatibility check and only the companion checks re-
quired by the exact selected product role and SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 before any coadd-owned state changes.
Under SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, unavailable or basis-incompatible response and incomplete covariance do not alter signal mem-
bership and do not reject an otherwise compatible base bundle; their exact identities, states, and causes remain. A required
companion incompatibility is atomically decisive only for SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1 or SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_
coadd@1 as applicable. If an exact base coadd parent already exists, such an incompatibility blocks the stronger role for that
parent and never selects a subset. A separately requested stronger-role admission may reject an observation only before
constructing its own explicitly identiﬁed base/signal parent. Every rejection leaves all aﬀected numerators, normalizations,
counts, exposure, response, validity, provenance, and product cardinality unchanged.
Minimum conformance evidence: Snapshot all role-owned and base-parent state; inject one base fact, response, and
covariance incompatibility at a time; verify role-speciﬁc admission, exact pre-mutation rejection, unchanged base membership,
and no companion-only subset.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-038 – Centered integer common grid
Canonical clause: A canonical target grid may be requested and made immutable before observation-map construction.
Observation maps constructed on that exact grid, or otherwise compatible observation/coadd shapes, shall use exact centered-
integer embedding: shape diﬀerences are nonnegative and even in each axis, and the corresponding integer oﬀset maps reference
pixels to the same world coordinate. A later crop is a newly identiﬁed row-selected product with immutable parent and lineage;
it shall not relabel the parent or make it retrospectively compatible. Fractional shift, post-hoc pad, reprojection, interpolation,
wrapping, implicit recentering, mosaicking, and a diﬀerent sky grid are outside this estimator.
Minimum conformance evidence: Test preconstruction target-grid requests, every parity/sign case and WCS reference-
pixel relation, exact integer embedding, a separately identiﬁed post-hoc crop, attempted parent relabeling, and each excluded
grid-changing operation.
Result: not_assessed

Canonical clause: Full-precision typed or sidecar WCS shall be the lossless admission and provenance authority. For an

scientiﬁcally addressable integer pixel center (j + 1, k + 1) for 0 ≤ j < n x, 0 ≤ k < n y, and (b) every outer-footprint cell vertex:

WCS-generation identity, celestial frame, axis order, signs, handedness, orientation, shape, and centered-integer reference-pixel
relation. At every population member, each WCS is evaluated at the exactly corresponding center (zero-based memory index
(j, k ), one-based FITS pixel (j + 1, k + 1)). Separation is the great-circle angle atan2(∥u × v∥, u·v) between unit direction
vectors in that exact declared frame, evaluated with IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even operations and reported

when its scientiﬁc row was already absent before population generation; every listed outer-boundary vertex remains required.

exact preregistered ﬁnite population; it is not a continuum or global-sky maximum. Exact axis sign, handedness, orientation,
and centered-integer shape/reference-pixel relations remain required independently of the numerical bound.
Minimum conformance evidence: Evaluate every preregistered center and outer-boundary vertex with the stated index
relation, frame, WCS generation, binary64 spherical metric, and invalid-point rule; calculate the exact ﬁnite-population
maximum and separately verify every orientation invariant.

SCI-MAP-REQ-047 – F ailure scope and atomicity
Canonical clause: An invalid required input, unauthorized above-one cut, incompatible bundle, unrepresentable ﬁnite

required publication shall propagate at its declared contribution, pixel, observation-admission, or complete-product scope and
shall fail before the aﬀected live state changes. A pre-application failure creates no applied or realized record. A failure after
application retains the exact applied attempt and terminal cause without fabricating a realized product or completion marker.
Base-role response/covariance unavailability permitted by REQ-037–041 is an honest state, not a role-independent atomic
rejection.

lifecycle, diagnostics, nonmutation, unchanged base parent, and absence of false application, realization, or completion.

A plan may instead permit a fully in-memory route. A coadd-only entry may consume persisted conforming observation bundles
without rerunning upstream processing. In-memory and persisted routes shall use identical logical admission, arithmetic,
role and base-parent identity, ﬁve-stage lifecycle, and provenance. Optional nonpublication does not imply that the logical
observation product did not exist, and this MAP rule does not waive PTC’s upstream atomic required-publication obligations.

SCI-MAP-REQ-049 – Immutable base parent
Canonical clause: Every stronger observation/coadd role and downstream transformation shall preserve the exact resolvable
base/unﬁltered MAP-bundle or base-coadd identity, ordered membership, lifecycle, and MAP-local base-product validity. A

Canonical clause: No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as a scientiﬁcally complete map. The boundary
shall include exact product role, request, base parent and membership; quantity and nominal-beam identity; estima-
tor/normalization/coeﬃcient/proﬁle identity; honest response class/state and uncertainty/covariance disclosure; distinct map

not own their eligibility. SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and stan-
dardization methods and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability,
false-rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavail-

and analyses that explicitly accept limitations; verify fail-closed claim scope, exact parent/membership, and no rewrite of MAP
validity.

SCI-MAP-REQ-052 – Method and claim separation
Canonical clause: Pointing and OOF may be registered consumers of the exact ordinary MAP gridding operator only

empirical noise, ﬁtting, Beammap inference, feedback, Stokes Q/U, measured-R mapmaking, or other units. Independent
inspection, modiﬁcation, experimentation, and proposal remain unrestricted, while an altered scientiﬁc identity or oﬃcial claim
requires an explicit versioned successor and evidence appropriate to that claim. Algebraic contract correctness, engineering
conformance, representation/response ﬁdelity, observational performance, and production readiness shall remain separate
claims.

6 Prediction execution matrix
Predictions are imported from the same shared authority. Engineering records attach ﬁxtures, bounds, artifacts, and
results; they do not rewrite the prediction.
SCI-MAP-PRED-001 – Uniform constant
Canonical prediction: For ﬁxed membership, a constant admitted input with uniform positive coeﬃcients produces
that constant on every support-authorized MAP-valid output row; numerator and normalization scale together, and
no unsupported scientiﬁc row is created.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-002 – Unequally weighted constant
Canonical prediction: For ﬁxed membership, unequal positive coeﬃcients still preserve the same constant on every
support-authorized output row, while normalization and conditional variance generally change with position; rows
outside that set have no normalized scientiﬁc value.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-003 – One-pixel hand calculation
Canonical prediction: For an authorized row with admitted zi and ai > 0, the exact triplet is (N, Q, ˆm) =
(∑ aizi, ∑ ai, ∑ aizi/ ∑ ai); an unauthorized row has no normalized scientiﬁc value.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-004 – One-hot boundary
Canonical prediction: A ﬁnite coordinate inside exactly one half-open cell has one Gpi = 1 , preserves unity over
pixels, and contributes only there. A coordinate on an internal upper edge belongs to the adjacent cell; a coordinate
on the outer upper extent or outside the grid contributes nowhere. Fractional splitting is not authorized.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending

full-procedure or PTC+MAP re-resolved numerical diﬀerence exists only when its complete authorized comparison-

state transition/discontinuity and need not equal the ﬁxed-state column.
Primary claim layer: Representation ﬁdelity.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending

SCI-MAP-PRED-012 – Threshold selector

SCI-MAP-PRED-014 – Role-qualiﬁed atomic rejection
Canonical prediction: A required companion incompatibility rejects the complete observation before coadd muta-
tion. Under SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, unavailable or basis-incompatible response does not change signal membership; it
yields unavailable coadd response with exact cause and no hidden subset or zero companion. Under a selected stronger
role, an incompatible required response or covariance blocks that role for an existing base parent; any separately
requested admission may reject the observation only before constructing its own explicitly identiﬁed base/signal par-
ent. Other required identity, unit, WCS, shape, policy, and parent incompatibilities remain atomic at their declared
role scope.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-015 – One-observation coadd
Canonical prediction: A SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1 containing one admitted base observation under the uniform di-
mensionless coeﬃcient family reproduces its signal on corresponding centered-integer authorized rows. Conforming
in-memory and persisted bundles give the same admission, identity, and arithmetic. Unavailable or basis-incompatible
upstream response leaves that signal membership unchanged and makes coadd response unavailable with exact cause.
SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1 reproduces response only when its exact base parent and every required response
identity are compatible.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-016 – Uniform observation coeﬃcients
Canonical prediction: On each authorized coadd row, two compatible observations produce their equal-observation
arithmetic mean and count-like normalization under SCI-MAP:uniform_observation_coadd_coefficient@1. Each requested
coadd role binds its own exact parent, lifecycle, and ordered membership; stronger companions do not change the
arithmetic membership of their exact base parent. The normalization is not precision.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-017 – Missing or invalid observation
Canonical prediction: An unsupported observation row contributes at no coadd row; an observation rejected by
the exact selected role contributes nowhere to that separately identiﬁed base/signal parent and does not increment
its count. A companion unavailable but permitted by the base role does not remove the observation. Neither case
creates a zero-valued scientiﬁc or companion substitute.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-018 – Centered integer placement
Canonical prediction: A canonical target grid requested before construction yields observation maps already
bound to that grid. Other compatible shape diﬀerences that are nonnegative and even produce the exact half-
diﬀerence row/column oﬀset; odd, negative, fractional, or WCS-inconsistent relations fail with no mutation. The
FITS representation comparison evaluates every preregistered addressable pixel center and outer-boundary cell vertex,
including all corners, with the exact spherical metric and invalid-point rule. A later crop is a new row-selected product
with its own identity and lineage and cannot relabel its parent as compatible.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-019 – Cross-observation covariance
Canonical prediction: For two maps with variances σ2
1, σ 2
2 and covariance c, a complete SCI-MAP:covariance_
qualified_coadd@1 over the exact base-coadd membership includes c through Σobs. If a required block is missing, that
stronger role is unavailable for the parent; the base role retains a partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or
unavailable state. No subset is formed, the block is never zero or independence, and equal-observation normalization
is not precision.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending

SCI-MAP-PRED-020 – Fixed noise operator
Canonical prediction: A deterministic admitted realization propagated with ﬁxed state yields the same support-
row identities and coeﬃcient-by-coeﬃcient AMAP,Π ≡ Aout and Bout as the signal path; recomputed state exposes a
named diﬀerence.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-021 – Sequential and parallel reduction
Canonical prediction: Integer facts, identities, masks, support, and cardinality agree exactly. Floating sums agree
with a preregistered operation-count/conditioning bound that is frozen before results are viewed and is not loosened
after failure.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-022 – No false signiﬁcance
Canonical prediction: A deliberate attempt to label signal times square root of merely formal weight as empirical
signiﬁcance is rejected or remains unmistakably labeled formal standardized signal.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-023 – No validity promotion
Canonical prediction: A downstream product may have its own use-local validity or eligibility but cannot change
MAP-local base-product validity or sever the base/unﬁltered MAP parent.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-024 – No ordinary predicate for JINC
Canonical prediction: A deliberate attempt to apply positive-coeﬃcient ordinary admission, support, or complete-
bundle availability to JINC is rejected as outside SCI-MAP v0.2.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-025 – Aggregate and index failure
Canonical prediction: An exact-zero, non-ﬁnite, overﬂowed, or unrepresentable aggregate/index never becomes a
live valid product; failure occurs at the declared scope before mutation or completion.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending

7 Mechanical completeness checks
Before a conformance verdict, automated checks shall establish:
• exactly one declaration of each stable requirement and prediction ID in the shared authority, with no gaps or
duplicates;
• every requirement appears in this speciﬁcation and in CROSSWALK.md; every prediction is linked to at least one
requirement;
• each rendered PDF identiﬁes contract v0.2 and its current document revision separately;
• no unresolved LaTeX reference, citation, overfull box, clipped glyph, broken table, or unreadable page remains;
• every required artifact reopens successfully, has the expected page count, and renders every page through an
independent PDF renderer; and
• the owner-decision ledger and author-draft decision record contain no silent resolution of an open scientiﬁc ques-
tion.
The conformance verdict uses the same exact ﬁve-value requirement-result vocabulary. It is pass only when every
applicable requirement is pass on the exact candidate. Any contradictory evaluated requirement makes it fail;
otherwise any missing named prerequisite makes it blocked; otherwise any applicable unevaluated requirement
makes it not_assessed. not_applicable is permitted only for a requirement outside the exact candidate’s declared
role with an owner-approved rationale. Evidence-artifact incomplete is never a requirement result. This document
records every placeholder as not_assessed and asserts no verdict.
8 Required handoﬀ contents
An engineering handoﬀ contains the candidate and authority identities; requirement result table using ex-
actly pass/fail/ blocked/not_applicable/not_assessed; a separate artifact-realization ﬁeld using exactly
complete/incomplete/ failed/not_produced; prediction result table; exact commands and environment; inde-
pendent expected-value artifacts; build/test/log outputs; representation and observational evidence where claimed;
failure-injection snapshots; skipped/blocked items; deviations and owner dispositions; and an explicit statement for
each claim layer. The handoﬀ shall not collapse “conforms algebraically,” “represents faithfully,” “performs on sky,”
and “ready for production” into one status word.
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 25
